profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Front-End / Client-Side: ReactJS | React Native | HTML | CSS/ SCSS | CSS Modules | JavaScript/ ES6 | Redux | MobX
CSS Frameworks: Bootstrap | Sass | Skeleton | Normalize | Materialize 
Design: Wireframing | Sketch | Figma  
Back-End / Server-Side: NodeJS | ExpressJS  | APIs  
 Databases: Firebase | MongoDB 
Management & Deployment: Git | GitHub | Jira | Command Line | Heroku 

I've always had a passion for health and fitness, so during my college years, I studied exercise science. I became really interested in the body and how it functions, how muscles work, and the positive impact that exercise has on the body. I find it absolutely incredible how the body is capable of doing so much. I feel like this can be translated to coding and is what intrigued me about programming. I am passionate about using technology to bring people together and improve the quality of their lives. Being able to write one line of code that can build and create functionality to an app is so exciting to me, and is what makes me want to continue learning all that I can!

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
- Coordinated with designers and developers to build digital web experiences that are elegant and seamless to use across all platforms.
- Managed updates and changes to web sites post launch. 
- QA and Beta test in sandbox environment.
- Development lead for Shaun White’s official site (shaunwhite.com) and Adventure Times (adventuretimes.co).

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
- Prepared and managed projects, audits and analyzed business plans.
- Worked under tight deadlines to manage client files, schedules and data entry. 
- Coordinated paperwork and information flow in office.
- Collected payments and managed transactions.
- Answered phone calls, emails and voicemails as needed.
- Provided great customer service and a welcoming environment for clients.

positions.title: Sales and Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
- Worked on upselling products and services, created seasonal marketing ideas, worked in teams to execute sales ideas and new promotions.
- Assisted with prospective member tours and sold memberships to
 incoming customers.
- Coordinated and conducted orientation training sessions with the goal of ensuring proper use of equipment, and reducing unnecessary injuries to members.
- Answered customer phone calls and assisted with registration for 
fitness classes.
- Provided front desk customer service and POS transactions.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Actively participated and learned different training techniques and methods from certified personal trainers
- Assisted new members in orientation sessions- helping individuals use all machines and equipment safely, and with proper form
- Gained knowledge in sales methods and daily administrative operations

positions.title: Hostess / Take-Out / Server
positions.description:
- Demonstrated ability to efficiently multi-task and problem solve in high stress 
environments. 
- Appropriately suggested additional items to customers to increase restaurant sales.
- Coordinated table set ups for large parties and groups.
- Delivered friendly and efficient customer service to ensure a pleasant dining experience for all guests.

projects.title: Fit Kids
projects.description: Three-model MEAN stack application for creating and sharing activities for children that encourage an active lifestyle.

projects.title: GetFit
projects.description: Two-model CRUD web application for creating fitness posts. It is a Pinterest for workouts!
